tools/run-check.mjs.note: the FIRST RUNNER adopter (Magpie, 2026-09-22, VERDICT-CONTRACT §3d): the object is a projection of ran/notRun/failedIdx + each step's exit code through the shared aggregateChildren — population = STEPS (checked = ran to an exit, excluded = never asked after an abort + a --steps= exclusion), status by precedence FAIL > SHORTFALL > UNKNOWN > PASS. Every step is still an exit code, so a real run reads UNKNOWN by provenance until the steps adopt — that is the point; a red step is FAIL; a --steps= subset is filtered:true with the consumer rule. --json prints the object (children → stderr); the exit code stays for the shell/CI. Fifteen §3d plants in --selftest; the cmd is a scratch step list.

tools/run-tests-verdict.mjs.note: the THIRD RUNNER adopter and the largest (Magpie, 2026-09-22, VERDICT-CONTRACT §3d) — the test runner's object, built here (pure) and called by tests/run-tests.mjs, which sits outside this gate's enumeration (tests/). A group is a child, an assertion is not (provenance 'assertions': a failing assertion ⇒ FAIL, passes ⇒ PASS, declared skips only ⇒ NOT_APPLICABLE, none ⇒ UNKNOWN); --group= and --shard= are declared exclusions ⇒ filtered with the consumer rule; the skip budget is the runner's one own criterion (undeclared skip ⇒ FAIL by name); the --jobs union aggregates the SHARD OBJECTS, a dead shard is an undeclared NOT_RUN ⇒ UNKNOWN (§4c made structural). --json payload carries `verdict` (a superset verify-shard-union still reads); the exit code stays. 32 plants; the cmd is three scratch shards, one dead.

tools/selftest-all.mjs.note: the second RUNNER adopter (Magpie, 2026-09-22, VERDICT-CONTRACT §3d), through the same aggregateChildren as run-check: children = the per-tool selftests read from the summary line the script already parses (provenance 'summary' with n) — a parsed count is PASS, green-but-unparseable is UNKNOWN never a tool failure, a failing selftest is FAIL, a timeout/kill is UNKNOWN (the tool decided nothing), a near-miss tool discovery cannot run is NOT_RUN/excluded and unplanned ⇒ UNKNOWN; the ratchet is the runner's one criterion of its own (an unratcheted unparseable tool or a paid debt left in the map ⇒ FAIL by name). Measured on the real sweep: UNKNOWN over 121/121 — 26 ratcheted-unparseable children, 1666 assertions counted. --json prints the object (report → stderr); the exit code stays. Ten §3d plants in --selftest; the cmd is a scratch result set.
